name: BKI Baukosten — Cost Plausibility Benchmarks
description: Validates cost estimates against BKI (Baukosteninformationszentrum) benchmark values (EUR/m2 BGF and EUR/m3 BRI) by building type, region and construction year. Flags outliers above the 95th or below the 5th percentile, checks typical cost group shares (KG 300/400/500/700) and verifies that regional and construction price indices are applied.
